scope.representativePointPolicy: one regional representative point per subregion; no per-course climate records
scope.observationPolicy: No daily real-time observation ingestion, station discovery, station boundary work, or station-based operational dependency

prohibitedClaims: daily rain probability without calibrated hindcast mapping
daily precision derived from monthly anomaly

sources.role: regional historical climate distribution and seasonal prior
sources.refreshPolicy: static baseline; refresh only when reference period or dataset version is intentionally revised

sources.role: primary forecast anomaly signal for D19-D46
sources.refreshPolicy: use latest available operational cycle; no daily station observations

sources.role: primary multi-model climate anomaly signal for D47-D90
variables: monthly precipitation anomaly and tercile probabilities
monthly 2m temperature anomaly and tercile probabilities
sources.refreshPolicy: monthly cycle; retain model/system/version and matching hindcast provenance

sources.role: optional secondary daily-shaped model signal for research and comparison only
sources.refreshPolicy: not an operational dependency until per-region hindcast verification passes
restrictions: daily-shaped output is not proof of daily forecast skill
no rain probability inferred from rainfall amount
do not use as sole D47-D90 forecast

decisionMethod.tripPattern: five days four nights with three golf rounds
decisionMethod.coreOutput: relative suitability ranking of departure windows within the same planning horizon
metrics: historical wet-day probability and rainfall amount distribution
forecast-adjusted wet-weather risk by weekly/monthly anomaly signal
historical daily Tmin/Tmax comfort distribution adjusted by calibrated temperature anomaly
probability of at least three playable days within the seven-day window

calibration.method: hindcast/reforecast-based quantile mapping and probability calibration, stratified by region, season and lead-time band
requiredMetrics: CRPS where ensemble distributions support it

decisionMethod.probabilityPolicy: Do not publish numeric daily rain or playable-day probabilities until matching hindcast validation demonstrates calibration. Until then publish categorical regional tendencies and relative ranking with explicit uncertainty.
decisionMethod.missingDataPolicy: Missing forecast or historical inputs remain unavailable; do not substitute zero or silently fall back to an unrelated model.

operations.d19D46Refresh: when new ECMWF extended-range cycle is available
operations.d47D90Refresh: when new C3S seasonal cycle is available

activationGates: 80 regional representative points remain structurally valid
1991-2020 regional historical climate distributions acquired and QA checked
ECMWF extended-range forecast and matching hindcasts are ingested with weekly valid periods
C3S multi-system forecast and matching hindcasts are ingested with model/version provenance
hindcast calibration and skill are reported separately for all four lead bands
seven-day / three-round ranking passes backtest without modifying D01-D16 or UI
